text:
jonathan_cust: Hey team — dashboards for tenant 'acme-io' show zero tokens for the US-west region after I change the time range from 1h to 24h. Filters (region=us-west, model=redwood-3-xl, version=v2) don't apply; charts stay at 'All regions'.

alex_support: Thanks for reporting — sorry about the trouble. Can you share the tenant id and a quick repro step? Does this happen for other tenants?

jonathan_cust: tenant id: tid-0457c
Repro steps:
1) Console > Analytics > Usage
2) Set time range to Last 1 hour — charts update correctly
3) Switch to Last 24 hours — region dropdown shows us-west selected but charts still show global totals
4) Click "Apply" again — now charts update, but selection sticks wrong on next page

alex_support: Got it. Two quick asks: a screenshot of the chart after switching (if you can), and the browser console logs (ctrl+shift+i -> Console). Also whether this is on https://console.redwood.ai/ or private prod.

jonathan_cust: screenshot: https://files.acme.com/screens/console-usw-24h.png
Console log snippet:

    TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined at filters.js:412
    at filterApply (filters.js:380)
    at Object.handleRangeChange (timepicker.js:58)

Also seeing a 200 response from /api/v1/metrics?range=24h&region=us-west&model=redwood-3-xl: payload has buckets for all regions, not filtered.

maria_engineer: tagging eng-runtime. From the stack trace it looks like a missing null-check in the filter normalization when time range causes the component to re-render with an empty version list. Suspect alias -> version map returns [] and code assumes first element exists.

maria_engineer: Quick local repro I ran:

curl -s "https://console-api.redwood.ai/api/v1/metrics?tenant=tid-0457c&range=24h&region=us-west&model=redwood-3-xl&version=v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" | jq .buckets | head

Result: API returns unfiltered buckets when client sends version param as empty string. Reproducer: set version param to "" and server falls back to global aggregation.

ops_lisa: Deploy-bot shows no recent deploys to console yesterday. @maria_engineer can you PR a fix to guards in filters.js and add unit test for empty-version path? Assigning to eng-runtime. :thumbsup:

maria_engineer: Yep. I'll patch normalization to treat missing version as explicit "null" filter and ensure backend rejects empty-string for version. PR list: #rwd/console#1428. Cutting a hotfix branch.

sre_max: Also adding a smoke check in observability: when user-selected filters mismatch query params (UI selection != request query) emit a warning metric. Should help catch regressions.

alex_support: Thanks all. Jonathan — we'll follow up once hotfix is deployed. ETA ~2h for hotfix to canary, full rollout in 6h pending smoke checks. For immediate workaround, re-open filter dropdown and re-select version before applying.

jonathan_cust: Thanks, workaround works. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rwd/console hotfix branch deployed to canary at 2025-06-18T11:08:12Z

maria_engineer: Canary looks good, metrics applying correctly now in canary. Rolling to prod in 4h.

alex_support: Closing loop — will follow up after prod rollout. If anything else pops up, please ping #support. :white_check_mark:
